source: scripts/build_astro_lite.py — impersonal slice; no user data, no desk output

ephem.units: tenths of a degree, sidereal (Lahiri), 00:00 UT

Jupiter.why: Jupiter is the classical karaka of treasury, credit and wealth; Mercury governs the transactional side.
Islamic finance sits under Jupiter (law and lawful wealth) with Mercury for the contracting.
Pooled wealth is Jupiter; its trading is Mercury.

Mercury.sector: Inv. Banks / Inv. Cos. / Securities Cos.
Mercury.why: Brokerage and trading are Mercury; the capital itself is Jupiter.
Mercury is communication and intellect; Rahu is disruption and the new.
Paper, print and the written word are Mercury's.
Mercury is movement and messages; Venus the conveyance itself.

Saturn.why: Saturn governs long-dated obligations; Jupiter the finance behind them.
Saturn rules longevity, risk and what endures; Jupiter the pooled capital.
Saturn is stone, construction and heavy industry; Mars is building and land.
Saturn governs oil and everything extracted from underground; Mars the drilling and the energy itself.
The commodity is Saturn's; the distribution and retail margin are Mercury's.
Saturn's crude processed by Mars's fire.
Saturn governs hides and the tanning trade; Venus the finished goods.

Mars.why: Mars is machinery and iron; Saturn the heavy industrial base.
Mars is the classical karaka of land and property; Saturn the structures on it.
Same as REITs — land is Mars.
Mars for chemical processing and fire; Rahu for the synthetic and the toxic.
Components are Mars's metal before they are Venus's vehicle.

Sun.why: The Sun is electricity and the state's licensing of it; Mars the generation.
Electricity is the Sun; the wiring and switching are Mercury.
The Sun is health and vitality; Ketu is medicine, healing and what cures by removal.

Moon.why: Demand follows crops and rainfall, which are the Moon's; the chemical manufacture is Mars's.
The Moon is nourishment and the mood of the mass consumer; Venus is comfort and the branded good.

Venus.why: Venus is sweetness itself; the Moon is the cane crop.
Edible oils and ghee are Venus; the crop behind them the Moon's.
Venus is the classical karaka of vehicles; Mars the iron and the engine.
Venus rules cloth; the Moon the cotton crop feeding it.
Venus for fabric, Rahu for the artificial fibre.
Venus for cloth; Saturn for wool and the animal husbandry behind it.
Venus for glass and ornament; Mars for the kiln.

Rahu.why: Rahu governs smoke and intoxicants; Saturn the addiction and the regulation.

system.bodies: the nine classical grahas (no outer planets)
system.method: sidereal = tropical − ayanamsa; the ayanamsa is derived each run by precessing Spica from its J2000 position (Chitrapaksha: Spica = 180° sidereal), never hardcoded. Positions are VSOP87/ELP-2000 (pymeeus), geocentric apparent.

discipline: Astro NEVER generates or gates a trade setup. It does not touch the Strategist, the Risk Officer, or the Auditor. It is a lens the desk reports and scores, nothing more.
